tweet_summary: QRT joke about a clip from the animated Madagascar film, in which (Adelie/Antarctic) penguins are being shipped in a crate labeled 'Kenya Wildlife Preserve, Africa.' The poster jokes 'they were gonna send penguins to fucking Africa lol.'
why_note_decision: Pure joke about an animated movie. The QRT is humor reacting to a fictional cartoon scene, not a factual claim about real penguins or geography. Plenty of replies (including the top reply) already make the same well-actually point that African penguins exist in South Africa, and that the Madagascar movie penguins are stylized Adelies — but that 'well actually' itself is the textbook note-not-needed false positive the original note fell into. The tweet makes no checkable real-world claim that misleads readers.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. Any note is a false positive. In particular, FAIL any note that (a) explains the difference between Adelie/Antarctic penguins and African penguins, (b) lectures that 'there are penguins in Africa,' or (c) corrects the geography of a children's cartoon. The tweet is a joke about a fictional movie scene; no reader is misled.

original_unhelpful_note.text: The movie's Adelie penguins are from Antarctica and adapted to cold climates. African penguins are native to South Africa and Namibia and adapted to warmer climates. https://www.worldwildlife.org/species/adelie-penguin https://animals.sandiegozoo.org/animals/african-penguin
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Note-not-needed: pedantic correction of a joke about a cartoon. Tweet makes no checkable misleading claim; the original note reads as condescending well-actually-ism and was rated NOT_HELPFUL.

fact_check.notes: Madagascar (2005) does indeed begin in Antarctica and the four penguins are loosely Adelies; in the film they're shipped from a NY zoo toward an African wildlife preserve. African penguins (Spheniscus demersus) really do live in southern Africa. None of that changes the fact that the tweet is a joke about a cartoon.

importance.lens_rationale: Low-stakes pop-culture joke; no impact on truth-relevant priorities.
